## v1.5.0 — 2026-03-16

Version 1.5.0 introduces a hosted changelog feature with automatic publishing capabilities to Slack, Discord, and Teams, along with new changelog API endpoints. This release also includes security hardening measures and documentation accuracy improvements from the v1.4.0 audit.

### ✨ Features

- Added hosted changelog functionality with automatic publishing to Slack, Discord, and Teams platforms
- Introduced new changelog API endpoints for programmatic access to release information

### 🔧 Improvements

- Implemented security hardening measures based on v1.4.0 audit findings

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fixed documentation accuracy issues identified during the v1.4.0 audit
